messages:
samantha: Heads-up — noticed console is switching some tenant traffic from v1->v2 when quota margins hit. Anyone else seeing sticky sessions break? Example rule: `X-API-Version` fallback -> route change. Repro steps: open tenant X, flip grace toggle, send repeated requests.
kevin: yep saw it. sticky cookie not honored when header present. routing logs show affinity key switching to v2 route after quota decider runs.
jay: is this only when we hit reserved capacity quota? or also soft throttles?
kevin: mostly reserved bursts. soft throttles still route but add `WARN` to telemetry. Problem: console shows green for v1 but actual hits go to v2 — confusing.
lisa: UI ask — can we add a per-tenant banner + explanation + example curl? e.g., `Notice: traffic routed to v2 due to capacity policy (see docs)` :info: 
samantha: yes banner + telemetry link (per-tenant) would help. Also need rollout UX: allow manual pin to v1 for N minutes with an override token.
jay: implementation thought: add `route_hint` cookie that supersedes quota decisions if `pin=true` for 5m. need guardrails so it can't be abused (rate-limit override).
kevin: prefer server side consume `x-tenant-pin` header signed by console w/short TTL. cookie tampering is messy.
lisa: from UX, header approach is fine if console can set HttpOnly cookie. But ops needs audit trail.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/route-pin-server-signing -> staging at 02:00 UTC :rocket:
samantha: telemetry: let's add event `tenant_route_override` with fields: `tenant_id, old_route, new_route, actor, reason` (sampling 100% for 24h then 1%).
kevin: also add a gauge for `sticky_miss_rate` and an alert if >0.5% over 10m.
jay: for deprecation messaging — console should show `v1 deprecated in 90 days` if tenant uses pin frequently. that nudges migration.
lisa: agree. small copy: `Your traffic is pinned to v1. Consider testing v2: <link>`
samantha: ok action items: kevin -> infra change (header signing); jay -> quick RFC on pin TTL + abuse guard; lisa -> UI banner + copy; infra-bot -> add telemetry events; follow-up in tomorrow eng-platform sync.
kevin: ack.
